description: Labelled relationship edges (owns, operates, supplies …) around ONE entity, with tier and provenance: start from entity_type + entity_id (or a name in `entity`), walk `hops` deep, filter by relation_type. `as_of` answers for a past date. An ambiguous name fails uncharged and lists the candidates. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

as_of.description: Answer for a past date: YYYY-MM-DD or a UTC datetime.

entity.description: Start entity by NAME: an exact (case-insensitive) match, else a name that contains it.

entity_id.description: The start entity's numeric id (with entity_type) — the unambiguous way to name it.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. Pins the start node with entity_id.

fields.description: Only these keys in each row (plus id). Omit for all.

hops.description: Traversal depth, 1-10 (agent keys). Default 1. The billing unit: priced per hop.

limit.description: Maximum edges to return, up to 100. Default 50.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

relation_type.description: Only edges with this relation label, e.g. OPERATES, CONTAINS, MEMBER_OF.

name: relationships
